why: Two major reviewers with real testing, WIRED [1] and Macworld [3], both name a 4-in-1 (Mophie, with 60W USB-C and 100W adapter) that charges all four devices from one plug, so the question is answered in part by tested sources. But neither page is about this question: they are 3-in-1 and MagSafe roundups where the MacBook-capable station is one entry, and nobody compares the handful of 4-in-1/6-in-1 stations against each other on laptop wattage under load. Everything else is 3-in-1 listicles, a brand page and an Apple Store listing. A focused 4-device comparison could get in, but it would compete with WIRED and Macworld rather than own the result.
